high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from the Instagram app, showing a dramatic scene of a lightning storm over a body of water during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset. The sky is filled with dark, ominous clouds illuminated by the intense red and orange hues of the lightning bolts striking down towards the water. The reflection of the lightning on the water's surface creates a striking mirror effect, enhancing the visual impact of the scene. The image has been shared by an account named "wildlytravel," which is suggested as a follow account.
